integrity.reproducibility: Standard-library Python checker and exact recorded output are included; general argument is symbolic.

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns complex symmetric matrices on spider trees with at least three arms and at least one nontrivial arm.
Only the reduced singular support and generic formal singularity type are determined; the full unreduced Jacobian scheme and component-intersection germs are not classified.
The aggregate total degree is classical and not claimed as novel.
Unindexed historical equivalent classifications remain possible.
title: Singular components and generic nodes of symmetric spider determinant hypersurfaces
